mt_01.normalized_query: How many orders included an item from seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0?
mt_01.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) 
FROM olist.order_items oi
JOIN olist.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE oi.seller_id = '6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0';

mt_01.normalized_query: How many delivered orders included an item from seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0?
mt_01.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE s.seller_id = '6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0' AND o.order_status = 'delivered';

mt_01.normalized_query: How many of the 1819 delivered orders that included an item from seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0 were paid by credit card?
mt_01.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
AND oi.seller_id = '6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0'
AND op.payment_type = 'credit_card';

mt_02.normalized_query: How many orders were paid using credit card?
How many orders paid using a credit card had more than 6 installments?
mt_02.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM olist.order_payments AS op
JOIN olist.orders AS o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE op.payment_type = 'credit_card' AND op.payment_installments > 6;

mt_02.normalized_query: How many orders paid using a credit card had more than 6 installments and a payment value over 200?
mt_02.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
FROM olist.order_payments op
JOIN olist.orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE op.payment_type = 'credit_card'
  AND op.payment_installments > 6
  AND op.payment_value > 200
LIMIT 1000;

mt_03.normalized_query: How many distinct products has seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0 sold?
mt_03.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_id)

JOIN olist.sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id

mt_03.normalized_query: How many reviews has seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0 received?
mt_03.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM olist.order_reviews OR
JOIN olist.orders O ON OR.order_id = O.order_id
WHERE O.seller_id = '6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0';

mt_03.normalized_query: How many 5-star reviews has seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0 received?
mt_03.executed_sql:

FROM olist.order_reviews OR

mt_04.normalized_query: How many orders came from customers in Sao Paulo state (SP)?
mt_04.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) 
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'

mt_04.normalized_query: How many orders came from customers in Rio de Janeiro (RJ)?
mt_04.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) 
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN olist.geolocation g ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE g.geolocation_city = 'Rio de Janeiro' AND c.customer_state = 'RJ'

mt_04.normalized_query: What is the average payment value for the orders from customers in Rio de Janeiro (RJ)?
mt_04.executed_sql:
SELECT AVG(op.payment_value) AS average_payment_value
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN olist.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN olist.geolocation g ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE g.geolocation_state = 'RJ'
LIMIT 1000;

mt_05.normalized_query: How many orders include an item in the bed_bath_table category?
mt_05.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'bed_bath_table';

mt_05.normalized_query: How many of the 9,417 orders that include an item in the bed_bath_table category got a 5-star review?
mt_05.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation p ON oi.product_id = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name_english = 'bed_bath_table' AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
AND o.order_id IN (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM olist.order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
)
LIMIT 1000;

mt_05.normalized_query: How many of the 9,417 orders that include an item in the bed_bath_table category got a 1-star review?
mt_05.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation p ON oi.product_id = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name_english = 'bed_bath_table' AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
AND o.order_id IN (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM olist.order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 1
)
LIMIT 1000;

mt_06.normalized_query: What is the ONDC network's return window in days for the electronics category, per the returns policy?
How many electronics orders took longer than 10 days to be delivered after purchase?
mt_06.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name_english = 'electronics' 
AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp) > 86400;

mt_06.normalized_query: How many electronics orders took longer than 10 days to be delivered after purchase where the customer is in Sao Paulo state?
mt_06.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation p ON oi.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation p2 ON p.product_category_name_english = 'electronics'
WHERE p2.product_category_name_english = 'electronics'
AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400 > 10
AND c.customer_state = 'Sao Paulo';

How many sellers are there in total?

mt_07.normalized_query: How many sellers have sold over 500 orders' worth of items?
mt_07.executed_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id)
FROM olist.sellers s
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
HAVING SUM(oi.price) > 500
LIMIT 1000;
